Lenovo has launched ThinkPad XI Fold, the world’s first foldable laptop which is claimed __to be so durable as __its other devices.
questions.solution:

__
 
• In the given underlined segment, the use of "so durable as" is incorrect as "**so...as**" can only be **used with negative** like 'not'.
 
• We use **not** + so + adjective/adverb + as to **make comparisons, meaning not to the same degree**.
 
• In the first option, '**most**' is used which is not a comparative adjective but a **superlative adjective**.
 
• In the third option, '**very**' is not generally comparable. We can use '**very**' **before superlative adjectives that end in -est.**
 
• But we use **as + adjective/adverb + as** to **make comparisons when the things we are comparing are equal in some way**.
 
• **Hence**, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence__: ***Lenovo has launched ThinkPad XI Fold, the world’s first foldable laptop which is claimed **to be as durable as** its other devices.*

• We can use "**as...as**" for **both negative and positive**, "**so...as**" can only be **used with negative**.

**Directions: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. This test is conducted on the fully automated Driving Test Track designed by Maruti Suzuki.

• The phrase "**these specific skills**" in the sentence 'B' refers back to the '**specific driving skills**' mentioned in the sentence 'C'. Hence, 'B' follows 'C'.

• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

questions.question: What disease is caused by insulin deficiency?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Diabetes Mellitus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Insulin is a type of **Peptide hormone.**
 
• It is produced by the beta cells of the **pancreatic islets.**
 
• The hormone is recognized as the **main anabolic hormone of the body.**
 
• It is responsible to regulate the metabolism of **carbohydrates, fats, and protein.​**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Diabetes mellitus** is a metabolic disease that causes **high blood sugar.**
 
• The insulin moves sugar from the blood cells into the other cells and used it as a form of energy.
 
• Diabetic patient doesn't make enough insulin or can't effectively use the insulin it does make.
 
• **Some of the important types of diabetes include -**

 
• Autoimmune diabetes
 
• Prediabetes
 
• Gestational diabetes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Diabetes insipidus (DI) and Diabetes mellitus (DM) are conditions characterized by abnormal regulation of fluids and sugars in the body, but they have different causes, symptoms, and treatments.

 
• Diabetes Insipidus (DI) is caused by deficiency of ADH (Antidiuretic Hormone).
 
• DI is primarily caused by a deficiency of antidiuretic hormone (ADH), also known as vasopressin. ADH is responsible for regulating the balance of water in the body.

Diabetes Mellitus (DM) is caused by Insufficient Insulin or Insulin Ineffectiveness: DM is characterized by insufficient insulin production (Type 1 DM) or ineffective use of insulin by the body's cells (Type 2 DM).

 
• Type 1 Diabetes: Results from the immune system destroying insulin-producing beta cells in the pancreas.
 
• Type 2 Diabetes: Develops when the body's cells become resistant to insulin or when the pancreas fails to produce enough insulin.

Key Differences:-

a)Hormonal Involvement:-

 
• DI: Involves a deficiency of ADH.
 
• DM: Involves insufficient insulin or insulin ineffectiveness.

b)Urine Characteristics:-

 
• DI: Results in dilute urine.
 
• DM: Causes the presence of glucose in the urine.
